verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
It will no longer be said, 'Forsaken'
It will no longer be said, 'Desolate'
But you will be called, 'My Delight is in You'
And to your land, 'Married'

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
By the blood of the Lamb
By the blood of the Lamb

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
You will no longer be called, 'Forsaken'
It will no longer be said 'Desolate'
But you will be called, 'My Delight is in You'
And to your land, 'Married'

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
For as the bridegroom rejoices
Over the bride
So the Lord your God
Rejoices over you

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
O precious blood
The blood of the Lamb
O precious blood
Poured out for us
